profile.headline: Success Plan Manager @ SAP | SAP Next Gen
profile.summary:
Tosha works with enterprise customers to help them adopt cloud solutions, achieve their business goals, and get the most value from their technology investments.

Their career has given them experience across customer success, technical consulting, software engineering, and cybersecurity.

Outside of technology, they earned their degree in International Security and Chinese and studied abroad in both China and Taiwan. Those experiences strengthened their interest in working across cultures and solving problems from both technical and business perspectives.

Today, they’re focused on helping organizations succeed with enterprise technology through strategic partnerships, customer success, and digital transformation. As their career continues to grow, they’re excited to deepen their expertise in SAP, enterprise consulting, and helping customers solve business challenges, not just technical ones.

projects.title: Northeast Flank Monitor
projects.description:
Northeast Flank Monitor is an open-source, non-commercial site that records observable military activity on NATO’s northeastern flank: Poland, the Baltic states, Belarus, Kaliningrad and the Baltic Sea. It documents what has been reported and makes no predictions.

I designed the product and directed its build using an AI coding assistant (Claude Code). An hourly pipeline collects reporting from about 35 monitored sources. Claude drafts candidate events with short source excerpts, and a person reviews and publishes every event, with an audit log of each decision.

What it includes:
• A region heat map with one fixed dot per area and no precise positions
• An exercise tracker with evidence rules for post-exercise reset
• A daily digest drafted by AI from published events only, then edited and approved by an editor
• A hand-built historical record (139 events, Aug 2020 – Feb 2022) with a descriptive side-by-side view
• A public JSON/CSV API under CC BY 4.0
• An Activity Index that is still collecting its baseline

Design decisions I’m proud of: claims are attributed to whoever made them, with no predictive language. Each source’s terms and robots.txt are checked before it is read. A public methodology page explains how everything works.

projects.title: Microsoft Stock Forecasting
projects.description: Utilizing popular machine learning algorithms such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and implementing a trading strategy based on the predicted prices and market signals generated by the models.
